title: B3tter
tagline: B3tter: Revolutionizing healthcare with Web3 & AI. Decentralized, secure, and AI-driven. Your personalized healthcare partner. Privacy, security, and global access. Join us!
description:
B3tter is a groundbreaking healthcare platform that leverages Web3 and AI technologies to provide personalized and community-oriented healthcare services while prioritizing data privacy and building user trust. With a strong focus on affordability and accessibility, B3tter offers an all-in-one healthcare solution that empowers users to take control of their health.

Key Features of B3tter:

Personalized Healthcare: B3tter utilizes advanced AI algorithms to offer personalized healthcare advice and solutions tailored to each user's unique needs and medical history.

Community Engagement: The platform fosters a sense of community by connecting users with healthcare experts, licensed physicians, and fellow users. It encourages open dialogue and knowledge sharing.

Data Privacy: B3tter employs cutting-edge data privacy measures, including account abstractions and decentralized storage, to ensure that user data remains secure and anonymous.

Affordability: B3tter is committed to making healthcare advice and services affordable to all users, removing financial barriers to accessing expert medical guidance.

Anonymized Data Sharing: Users can easily share their healthcare data with approved third parties, such as insurance companies, primary care physicians, and emergency contacts, while maintaining data anonymity.

Global Impact: B3tter's mission extends beyond serving users in developed countries. It actively contributes to improving global healthcare by partnering with non-profits like Vitamin Angel to provide essential healthcare resources to underserved populations in developing countries.

Ad-Revenue Sharing Model for B3tter:

B3tter's ad-revenue sharing model is a unique approach to monetization that benefits both the platform and its users while making a positive impact on global healthcare access. Here's how it works:

Ad Revenue Generation: B3tter collaborates with healthcare-related advertisers and sponsors to display advertisements strategically within the platform.

Revenue Sharing: When users interact with these advertisements, B3tter earns revenue from advertisers. A portion of this revenue goes to the platform, while the remaining portion is distributed among users.

User Choice: B3tter empowers users to decide how to use their share of the ad revenue. Users can either keep their earnings or choose to donate a portion or all of it to partner non-profits like Vitamin Angel.

Transparency and Accountability: The platform maintains transparency by providing clear information on ad revenue earnings and their impact on non-profit initiatives. Regular updates and reports are shared with users.

Global Impact: By implementing this ad-revenue sharing model, B3tter not only benefits its users but also contributes to global healthcare access. Partnering with non-profits enhances the platform's social impact by supporting healthcare initiatives in developing countries.

B3tter's mission is to revolutionize healthcare by combining the power of Web3 and AI, ensuring that everyone has access to affordable, personalized, and communal healthcare services while making a positive global impact through its ad-revenue sharing model.
how_its_made:
Next.js + React: The front-end of B3tter was developed using Next.js and React, which allows for efficient server-side rendering and building user-friendly web applications.
Vercel: CI/CD 

TypeScript: TypeScript was used throughout the project for static typing, improving code quality and maintainability by catching type-related errors early in the development process.

WalletConnect: WalletConnect technology was integrated into B3tter, providing users with the flexibility to choose their preferred wallet and protocol for secure login and transactions.

IPFS (InterPlanetary File System): IPFS is a fundamental component of B3tter's architecture, offering decentralized and secure storage for user data. Files were encrypted and uploaded to IPFS, ensuring data privacy and redundancy.

Celo, Polygon zkEVM, and FEVM: These blockchain protocols are leveraged to deploy smart contracts that manage the uploading and downloading of medical records from IPFS objects. Polygon zkEVM is used for account abstraction, optimizing gas efficiency and user experience.

Lit Protocol: Lit Protocol plays a pivotal role in B3tter, providing conditional access controls, a secondary layer of encryption, and facilitating interactions with third-party entities. This integration enhanced data security and access management.

Hugging Face Large Language Model: B3tter harnesses the power of the Hugging Face large language model for AI-driven healthcare recommendations and interactions. This model enables natural language understanding and generation, making it an essential component for user interactions and medical advice.
